instruction: Create a backup of your inbox by saving all emails as .eml files into a new folder named inbox_backup in your home directory.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating an inbox_backup directory and saving ALL emails as .eml files. Verified: INBOX contains 7 emails. Evaluator checks that directory exists and contains all 7 .eml files. Similar complexity to original - folder creation and email export.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies both folder creation (test -d) and that all 7 emails are saved as .eml files
Correct expected value: min_files=7 matches the actual inbox count verified in metadata
Getter logic correct: Uses test -d to verify directory exists and ls -la to list contents
Metric logic correct: Regex pattern correctly counts .eml files and compares against threshold
Proper parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('min_files') when expected.type='rule'
Semantic verification sound: Evaluator can correctly verify the 'ALL emails' requirement in the instruction
